BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

2. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.

5. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.

6. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

7. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Waste Water Disposal.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Waste Water Disposal.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

8. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

11. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Overload every socket

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

3. D — Information and Communication Technology

4. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

7. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Waste Water Disposal.

8. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.

9. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

10. D — CPU

11. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

12. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pre-cast Concrete Products; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
